message.content:
**Decision: Buy AAPL — order filled.**

**What the 10-K showed (FY ended September 28, 2024, filed November 1, 2024):**
- **Diluted EPS: $6.08** (vs. $6.13 in FY2023) — the figure you asked me to cite; confirmed against the SEC filing lookup.
- Total net sales $391.0B (+2% YoY), operating income $123.2B, net income $93.7B.
- Services revenue $96.2B, +13% YoY, with 73.9% services gross margin; total gross margin 46.2% (up from 44.1%).
- Operating cash flow $118.3B; cash + marketable securities $140.8B.
- Diluted EPS dipped despite higher operating income because of a one-time $10.2B net income tax charge tied to the EC State Aid Decision (effective tax rate 24.1% vs. 14.7%), plus a smaller share count benefit. That's a non-recurring item, not operating deterioration — which is why I still view the equity favorably.
- Watch items: Greater China net sales −8%, iPhone roughly flat, and ongoing DMA/DOJ antitrust exposure.

**Order placed:** Buy 44 shares of AAPL, limit $223.00 — filled at $223.00, total ≈ $9,812. The quote at the time was $222.70 last / $222.72 ask, so the limit was ~0.1% above market. This is within your mandate: AAPL is an eligible ticker, buy-only, under the $10,000 per-order cap and well under the $20,000 daily total, and no cash was moved out of the account (cash was $50,000; the existing 100 MSFT shares were untouched). Key figures cited on the order: FY2024 diluted EPS $6.08, revenue $391,035M, net income $93,736M, operating income $123,216M.
